data.body:
Live Merge Bot rehearsal on the fork's actual 8.4, 9.7, and trunk product trees.

Adds an inert public test-data fixture on 9.7. It should propagate to trunk; 8.4 must remain unchanged during this forward integration. Unlike the documentation-only prototype, this path triggers actual GCC/Clang builds and all four MTR shards, with `main.1st` rehearsal coverage and unit tests.


Phase 1 must finish version testing before generated integration PRs are opened. Phase 2 squashes this source PR, then creates/merges the trunk PR using the actual squash commit.

Every integration uses normal forward merges through trunk. A separately prepared older-version PR follows the same forward chain; there is no version-stop or intentional null-merge mode.

Requires real current-head collaborator approval and trusted OCA verification. Do not merge manually; after readiness, a configured maintainer posts a fresh `/integrate` so the workflow itself performs the integration. Baseline setup is tracked in #63.
